o.text: Ultimately from Sogdian [script needed] (kand, “city”). Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (kend, “city, settlement”), Turkish kent, etc.

Vulgarised form of ari, from Classical Persian آری (ārē).
Often explained according to folk etymology as a blend of hə + bəli, exhibiting the sound change r > l.
